mean_cn: n.柄，把手；  v.处理，解决；（用手）触；操纵（车辆、动物、工具等）
mean_en: the part of a door, drawer, window, etc. that you use to open it; the part of an object, such as a cup, a bag or a tool, that you use to hold it or carry it
sentence: Turn the handle and the door will open.
word_etyma: hand手 + le表示做某种动作时所使用的东西 → handle柄，把手
